programme.title: 璀璨之城 & 今日知多D / This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼…….

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机…….

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 美食强人 / Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: 由名厨权威品评、食家真实试炼，四十间餐厅角逐十强美食代表！「视帝」陈豪、「视后」龚嘉欣化身《美食强人》，以焗猪扒饭、云吞面、西多士、乳鸽、汉堡包、虾饺等十大主题，严选大湾区最强美食指南。团队深入餐厅重地，一探鲜为人知的美味故事。城中名厨、知名食家、嘴刁艺人等组成试食团，也会秘密探店，将真实食评报告带回录像厂。一轮舌战与点评，主题美食的强人认证店随即诞生！观众亦可参与投票，选出「我最喜爱的美食」。.

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。\n\n故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。.

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。.

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？.

programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。.

programme.title: 骗中传奇 / Game of Deceit
programme.desc: 第四集\n孔不忿玉放走二人,遂使出横手令正等人再次入狱,更从井师父生手上取得假铜币做证. 公堂上,玉利用化金水将铜钱藏金技两拆穿,不料铜钱真的藏有真金. 玉明查暗访下,终查出铜钱藏金乃生所为. 生力劝正要重新做人,不要再令实费心,正动容. 生在玉面前露了一手,玉将此事告之孔,孔露出不安神色. 大街上,群众均为铜钱而起争执,情况十分混乱. 儿遇上井,利用美色骗井说出真相,幸正及时出现,井才没有出卖生. 分辨铜钱藏金方法终被玉想出,生暗自担心.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机…….

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！

吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。

小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！

节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。.

programme.title: 美食强人 & 今日知多D / Big Feast Duel & What's On Today
programme.desc: 由名厨权威品评、食家真实试炼，四十间餐厅角逐十强美食代表！「视帝」陈豪、「视后」龚嘉欣化身《美食强人》，以焗猪扒饭、云吞面、西多士、乳鸽、汉堡包、虾饺等十大主题，严选大湾区最强美食指南。团队深入餐厅重地，一探鲜为人知的美味故事。城中名厨、知名食家、嘴刁艺人等组成试食团，也会秘密探店，将真实食评报告带回录像厂。一轮舌战与点评，主题美食的强人认证店随即诞生！观众亦可参与投票，选出「我最喜爱的美食」。.

programme.title: 港女野人 / Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: 第13集\n越野大冒險\nNicole換上短髮新形象，與Amber體驗越野冒險。二人來到越野場地，參與農夫車發燒友的車聚。眾人何以情迷農夫車？車身拉花更是粗獷有型！兩位港女主持初體驗四驅越野車，在崎嶇不平場地「攀山涉水」，尖叫聲不絕於耳！Nicole急不及待挑戰攀大斜坡、下水坑，再駛越高低起伏的炮彈坑洞，姿勢十足，何故竟被卡在山坡？Amber亦大顯身手，駕駛小童版越野車感受顛簸！車聚凝聚志同道合者互助互動，其樂無窮！.

programme.title: 璀璨之城 / This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼…….

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。.

programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。.

programme.desc: 《九门》讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局。一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛。生死抉择、兄弟之情、门派担当与家国大义相互交织。九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关。.

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。.

programme.title: 千奇百趣特工队 / Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7)
programme.desc: 森美、小仪这对奇趣拍文件再现屏幕，这次化身特务首领，将来自台湾、日本、香港的爆趣片段送给观众。每集艺人嘉宾分成两组，各自发挥想象力，与首领一起解答有关爆趣片段的超级难题，他们还可以向两位美女「趣特务」要求提示，不过情报孰真孰假，可要自行判断。表现最差的嘉宾要接受首领的「再培训」，到底有何惩罚等待一众来宾？.

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。\n\n故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。.

programme.desc: 第四集\n孔不忿玉放走二人,遂使出横手令正等人再次入狱,更从井师父生手上取得假铜币做证. 公堂上,玉利用化金水将铜钱藏金技两拆穿,不料铜钱真的藏有真金. 玉明查暗访下,终查出铜钱藏金乃生所为. 生力劝正要重新做人,不要再令实费心,正动容. 生在玉面前露了一手,玉将此事告之孔,孔露出不安神色. 大街上,群众均为铜钱而起争执,情况十分混乱. 儿遇上井,利用美色骗井说出真相,幸正及时出现,井才没有出卖生. 分辨铜钱藏金方法终被玉想出,生暗自担心.

programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼…….

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机…….

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 美食强人 / Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: 由名厨权威品评、食家真实试炼，四十间餐厅角逐十强美食代表！「视帝」陈豪、「视后」龚嘉欣化身《美食强人》，以焗猪扒饭、云吞面、西多士、乳鸽、汉堡包、虾饺等十大主题，严选大湾区最强美食指南。团队深入餐厅重地，一探鲜为人知的美味故事。城中名厨、知名食家、嘴刁艺人等组成试食团，也会秘密探店，将真实食评报告带回录像厂。一轮舌战与点评，主题美食的强人认证店随即诞生！观众亦可参与投票，选出「我最喜爱的美食」。.

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。\n\n故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。.

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。.

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？.

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。.

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 香港早晨 及 世界观 / Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。.

programme.title: 骗中传奇 / Game of Deceit
programme.desc: 第五集\n玉在井中放下大量盐份,令藏金铜币可沈下井底,而冇金铜币则会浮于水面,籍此分出真假. 另边厢,生亦想出破解之法,他命正及井于水井周围倒下大量醋,若然天下大雨,则醋将会浸入井水,无论铜币有金或冇金,均会沈下井底. 验证铜币当天,天下大雨,令生计划能顺利进行,玉却被结果吓得呆住. 铜币起货日期将至,孔唯有约生往观音庙内面谈. 面谈结果,孔用五百两及碧绿观音手,用作交换生破解玉落盐验证之法.

programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机…….

programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！

吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。

小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！

节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。.

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 / The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: 铁汉李家鼎(鼎爷)武艺非凡毋庸置疑，原来厨艺亦相当「耍家」！鼎爷设立「阿爷厨房」，伙拍对美食素有要求的谭玉瑛，每集带大家搜购心水食材，并由鼎爷亲自下厨，炮制多道拿手小菜、汤水及甜品，为大家奉上怀旧粤菜好滋味！如何以「抵食价」煮出正宗古法盐焗鸡的味道？怎样掌控蒸鱼的火候和时间？秋冬时份，不少人爱吃「香喷喷」煲仔饭，更不会错过香脆的饭焦，但大家又可曾见过有两面饭焦的煲仔饭？且看鼎爷大显身手，一一教路！.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。.

programme.title: 九门 & 今日知多D / Mystic Nine & What's On Today
programme.desc: 《九门》讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局。一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛。生死抉择、兄弟之情、门派担当与家国大义相互交织。九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关。.

programme.title: 美食强人 / Big Feast Duel

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。.

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。.

programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。.

programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。\n\n故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导& 世界观 & 今日知多D / News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。.

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机…….

programme.title: 璀璨之城 / This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼…….

programme.title: 九门 / Mystic Nine
programme.desc: 《九门》讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局。一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛。生死抉择、兄弟之情、门派担当与家国大义相互交织。九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关。.

programme.title: 美食强人 / Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: 由名厨权威品评、食家真实试炼，四十间餐厅角逐十强美食代表！「视帝」陈豪、「视后」龚嘉欣化身《美食强人》，以焗猪扒饭、云吞面、西多士、乳鸽、汉堡包、虾饺等十大主题，严选大湾区最强美食指南。团队深入餐厅重地，一探鲜为人知的美味故事。城中名厨、知名食家、嘴刁艺人等组成试食团，也会秘密探店，将真实食评报告带回录像厂。一轮舌战与点评，主题美食的强人认证店随即诞生！观众亦可参与投票，选出「我最喜爱的美食」。.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 / EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 世界观 / Global View
programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club

programme.title: 骗中传奇 / Game of Deceit
programme.desc: 第五集\n玉在井中放下大量盐份,令藏金铜币可沈下井底,而冇金铜币则会浮于水面,籍此分出真假. 另边厢,生亦想出破解之法,他命正及井于水井周围倒下大量醋,若然天下大雨,则醋将会浸入井水,无论铜币有金或冇金,均会沈下井底. 验证铜币当天,天下大雨,令生计划能顺利进行,玉却被结果吓得呆住. 铜币起货日期将至,孔唯有约生往观音庙内面谈. 面谈结果,孔用五百两及碧绿观音手,用作交换生破解玉落盐验证之法.

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。.

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？.

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。.

programme.title: 香港早晨 / Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。.

programme.title: Mean Talk / Mean Talk
programme.desc: 全新非一般Talk骚《Mean Talk》，主持林盛斌、江美仪每集邀来星级嘉宾，以最Mean方式，要对方大胆讲真话。内容涉及入行以来最委屈经历、最匪夷所思娱圈秘闻、听过最「直线挑机」的说话、影视生涯最污点节目！称得上「Mean Talk」，嘉宾就要放下底线被Mean与Mean人。访谈之前，嘉宾更要签署「Mean爆生死状」，承诺剖白真心话，抽中问题，诚实作答，实行以「揞名爆」形式，唔开名，讲真相！.

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。.

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！

吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。

小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！

节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。.

programme.title: 破毒强人 / Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: 第26集\n浩天等人來到福田的藏身地點，福田逃走至隧道被文華攔下……福田手下全叔將福田的毒品載到文華和章琳面前，原來文華早已買通全叔。隨着福田之事，章琳、安樂、可兒和子穎都回歸到平常生活，唯獨浩天仍死咬文華不放。尚榮找到全叔替福田匯款的證據，抓了全叔回來盤問，卻不知其實是文華為了引出身邊內鬼所放的誘餌……尚榮誘騙全叔致電手下搬走毒品，浩天等人趕往地點卻未有所獲；尚榮被引至儲物櫃，及後遇到殺手伏擊…….

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼IV / Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc:
语「㜺鬼」传神，博大精深，香港不少俗话亦源自广东省各地。

㜺鬼大使麦美恩遂将探索版图扩展至中国，并找来邓智坚、戴祖仪、许文轩加入「㜺鬼导赏团」，深入广州等内地城市，发掘相关的有趣典故及出处。专业粤语及典故专家亦会现身，追源溯古引经据典，揭示贴地粤语的魅力所在。

此外，喜欢扮鬼扮马的邓智坚还于节目化身单身宅男，透过他追求一众「女神」的过程，让大家了解多个俗语及术语的含意。.

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT
programme.desc: 会用尽所能搜罗世界各地至潮、至新情报，上至世界盛事、医学百科、文艺与科技；下至日常生活、网络热搜，在每个星期六跟观众一一分享。论尽天南地北，畅谈人气热话，「谷友」紧贴节目，便可轻松掌握全球脉搏动向。.

programme.title: 试真D唷 / Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: 江美仪再度领军，携手张振朗、朱敏瀚、吴业坤、曾展望组成「试真D团队」，在首季热播及网民的热烈推崇下载誉归来。这趟全新的台湾深度探索之旅，各人将继续以轻松真实、贴地玩乐的风格，引领观众深入宝岛腹地。团队前赴高雄、台南与台北，延续节目精神，发掘在网络上评价两极的争议店铺，以及隐藏于城市角落、鲜为人知的小众新奇体验。众人坚持呈现最真实的现场反馈，旨在为观众打造一本不踩坑的实用游台指南。.

programme.title: 女神配对计划2 / A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: 恋爱真人骚《女神配对计划》火热回归，第二季恋爱战场全面升级！「金牌媒人」Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，为女神何沛珈、郭佩文、陈若思、俞可程、阮嘉敏开展恋爱配对。求爱勇者接受心动揿灯、五角枱约会等挑战，各出奇谋冧女神。一对一亲密游戏引爆心跳警报，还有隐藏女神加入战团，火花进一步升温……更多求爱考验来临，勇者们力求走到最后，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神与星级嘉宾们轮流成为「花生团」，直击女神约会实况。.

programme.title: J Music / J Music 2026
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高质音乐平台，一众歌手有展示音乐实力的机会之余，也可让乐迷更深入了解歌手的音乐故事。节目邀请「人气」歌手担任嘉宾，由嘉宾亲自挑选其喜欢的新旧作品，并即场演唱，分享喜爱曲目。而一些乐坛新面孔亦会亮相，透过互动交流，展现音乐潜力。此外，每集紧贴「劲歌金榜」最新形势，送上歌曲MV外，还会带来不同歌手、创作人或制作人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至音乐业界的人和事。.

programme.title: 邵逸夫奖2026 / Shaw Prize Special 2026, The
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫生命科学与医学奖，平均颁予安妮‧德尚、戴宇阁及陈竺，以表彰他们发现急性早幼粒细胞白血病在分子与细胞层面的致病基础，并开创了协同标靶治疗方案，令这种疾病从最致命的癌症行列，转变为治愈率最高的癌症之一，治愈率超过九成。.

programme.title: 美食新闻周报 / Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食！黄嘉雯、倪嘉雯、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新美食潮流，从不同平台网罗超「人气」餐厅消息，主持亲自试食，带来真实食评；发掘各区「扫街」名物，又相约居港多年外籍人士，到访经他们认证的家乡风味食肆；名厨、食评家亦会带路「搵食」，带来专业推介。节目精选《美食新闻报道》介绍的多间「人气」餐厅，力推当中招牌美食，并会速递美食优惠，让观众实时掌握最滋味、抵食的饮食情报。.

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 / The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: 铁汉李家鼎(鼎爷)武艺非凡毋庸置疑，原来厨艺亦相当「耍家」！鼎爷设立「阿爷厨房」，伙拍对美食素有要求的谭玉瑛，每集带大家搜购心水食材，并由鼎爷亲自下厨，炮制多道拿手小菜、汤水及甜品，为大家奉上怀旧粤菜好滋味！如何以「抵食价」煮出正宗古法盐焗鸡的味道？怎样掌控蒸鱼的火候和时间？秋冬时份，不少人爱吃「香喷喷」煲仔饭，更不会错过香脆的饭焦，但大家又可曾见过有两面饭焦的煲仔饭？且看鼎爷大显身手，一一教路！.

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT
programme.desc: 会用尽所能搜罗世界各地至潮、至新情报，上至世界盛事、医学百科、文艺与科技；下至日常生活、网络热搜，在每个星期六跟观众一一分享。论尽天南地北，畅谈人气热话，「谷友」紧贴节目，便可轻松掌握全球脉搏动向。.

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 / News At 18:30
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。.

programme.title: 新闻透视 & 社畜求生101 / News Magazine 2026 & Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: 《新闻透视》，每周专题报导多段香港以至国际的瞩目新闻，聚焦港人最关心的民生话题，并邀请各界人士、学者、专家，一同深入探讨个中来龙去脉。.

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: Grand住去首尔 / Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: 「Grand住旅行团」又再出发，高海宁、周嘉洛、朱敏瀚会叹住畅游首尔！主持们会朝圣当地星级餐厅、品尝顶级韩牛。美食行程外，两位男生更获安排与韩国明星兼「健身Icon」金钟国一同热血操肌，之后再尽情大啖吃烧肉。三人亦获安排贴心私人行程，海宁跟陶瓷艺术家来一趟浪漫约会；朱仔体验精致西装订造，尽显型男风采；嘉洛则亲试顶流韩星同款的专属造型设计，华丽变身。尊贵的玩味体验，引领观众感受首尔极致奢华的魅力！.

programme.title: 香港连场好戏 / Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: 香港拥有独特的城市气质，新旧风貌并存，加上多元文化交融，在光影流转下成就「连场好戏」！主持黎诺懿、赖慰玲引领观众游走不同电影场景，回味经典桥段与金句，唤起一幕幕触动人心的回忆。跟随节目精选路线，欣赏璀璨的城市风光，沉浸于电影中的世界。主持还会示范打卡技巧，教大家用镜头捕捉这座「光影之城」的独有情怀。此外，电影演员重游取景旧地，回顾昔日拍摄点滴；动作指导细谈设计动作场面的心得，带出港式电影的魅力。.

programme.title: 奇情谷 / Mystery Files
programme.desc: 爱情，是一门极其复杂的学问，而且周边充斥着不少可更改对爱情憧憬、认知的「环境因素」，也会随着年龄变更、网络文化、骗案萌生等似怪不怪的原因，让社会衍生一段段光怪陆离、打破三观的感情故事。TVB Plus直播节目《奇情谷》，主持火火、吴若希、曾展望邀请各方人士、艺人嘉宾、情感专家，针对每集的主题，以独特的视角、刁钻的问题，大尺度探讨感情疑难，同时欢迎观众透过直播聊天室、语音来电，一同交流，拆解难题。.

programme.title: 直播灵接触 / You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: 《直播灵接触》载誉归来，第二季继续由「鬼王」梁思浩带领主持拍档黄耀英、黄紫恩，以及小编黄滢仴、汤之欣，为观众带来更多惊吓与惊喜。每集锁定不同灵异主题，诚邀「重量级」嘉宾讲鬼故，揭开法科风俗与行业秘闻。世界之大无奇不有，节目网罗各地「阴讯」，紫恩还会前赴韩国与台湾，一探当地异闻。跟观众实时互动亦是「灵接触」亮点，团队紧贴直播.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge
programme.desc: A weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Being Quiet Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn't like noise time to earn their Being Quiet badges!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Pen Pal Badge
programme.desc: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals, helping them to learn all about life in far away places, earning their Pen Pal badges and making some new friends in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bin Night
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Muffin Cone
programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Duck Cake
programme.desc: Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys. But nothing can tempt her to clean up, until Dad drops the cake.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Handstand
programme.desc: At a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna can't find a way to make herself useful. They're both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Elephant, Animal with Special Feet
programme.desc: Finn and family discover how tall an elephant can grow to!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - How the Red Kangaroo Stays Cool
programme.desc: Bora and Brody get Pio to show feverish Finn how a kangaroos in the Australian outback keep cool in the heat.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Prairie Dog Pups
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Chihuahua, Northern Mexico to discover how a colony of black tailed prairie dogs protect their pups from prowling bull snakes, hawks and coyotes as the pups take their critical first steps above ground.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Mixed Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dispy, Laa­Laa and Po have their favourite things. The bag, the hat, the scooter and the ball all magically swap places and become mixed up.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S03 - Tiger
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'tiger' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a big tiger, a baby tiger, a stripy tiger and a growling tiger. We meet a swimming tiger, a climbing tiger, a cheeky tiger and even a tiger at a tea party! The journey is repeated with some surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Messy Gets Clean
programme.desc: It's wash day in Okido. Messy travels with Zoe and Felix to the Okido launderette and learns just how much soap can be too much. Soon Okido is covered in bubbles and it's up to Messy to clean up.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Happy Happy Valentines
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to deliver a superfun singing valentine. But the problem is, they don't know who it's for, or who it's from. Preston is racing to beat them to it!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mariana Trench: The Pacific Ocean
programme.desc: With the help of his hero Ron Allum, Lars plans to dive to the bottom of the Mariana Trench in a submersible called the Deep Sea Challenger. Glitch plans to beat him there by sending a Grimbot in his Grimsub, but it can't withstand the heavy pressure of the water. Lars and Xuli must work together to mount a rescue operation at the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Grandad
programme.desc: Grandad is supposed to be resting, but when Bluey and Bingo go to visit him, he makes a run for it with the kids and takes them on a madcap adventure into the bush.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Baby Triceratops
programme.desc: Andy heads out on a mission to find a herd of triceratops so that he can place one of Jen's tracking devices on them. Along the way, he discovers a baby triceratops that needs his help.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Scarf
programme.desc: It's chilly, so Bella and Lift have fun with a snuggly scarf. In Boxtropolis, Sketch and the Playtimers make a no-snow snowman out of scrunchie socks and scarves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: It's one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hurricane Rescue
programme.desc: Grim HQ struggles through the sky above the Atlantic Ocean, fighting against the powerful winds of a hurricane. One Grimbot falls overboard before the ship crash-lands at Go Jet Academy. Needing another ship to rescue the missing Grimbot, Grandmaster Glitch steals Jetpad. The Go Jetters give chase in the Grimbler, heading right into the eye of the storm.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Biogas Power
programme.desc: Glitch is excited when Lars refits the Grimbler with new, clean biogas boosters that could make it even faster than the Vroomster! The boosters run on gas made from food waste, and luckily there is plenty of leftover food in the academy canteen for the Grimbots to gather up. But Glitch overloads the boosters and BOOM! programme.title: The Loud House S8 - Only Mime Will Tell / The Winning Spirit
programme.desc: For her try-out for the Varsity Mime Team, Luan must be silent for an entire day. // Afraid of failing her PE exam again, Lucy recruits the Morticians Club to help her pass.

programme.title: The Loud House S9 - Garbage Dumped
programme.desc: Lana tries to save the town garbage man's job when she finds out the mayor is replacing him with an automated garbage truck.

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay S2 - Lay Lay's Beauty Shop Day Day
programme.desc: It's Lay Lay and Sadie's first-time accompanying Trish to her standing appointment at the Beauty Shop. When Lay Lay starts spilling all the tea, she and Sadie are left with a big mess to clean up in order to get Trish un-banned from the salon.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - A Midsummer Night's Scheme
programme.desc: Max agrees to mentor Captain Perfect's younger sister, who is headed down the path of becoming a supervillain. But he has his hands full when she tries to become one of Mastermind's henchmen. Phoebe tries to help BC ask Chloe to the school dance.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Secret Room
programme.desc: Captain Man reveals a "Crimefighters Only" room in the Man Cave. Jealous, Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up. As the gang fights over who gets the better room, things get blown out of proportion.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - My Dinner with Bigfoot
programme.desc: When the gang befriends Bigfoot in the woods, Kid Danger and Captain Man try to help get rid of a pesky hunter that's been trying to capture him.

programme.title: Danger Force S1 - Earth To Bose
programme.desc: Strange things start to happen to Bose when he finds himself in love with an alien.

programme.title: iCarly S5 - iApril Fools
programme.desc: Carly and Spencer are being evicted from their apartment, and the gang reminisces about their time in Bushwell Plaza. Although, their memories may not be quite how we remember them.

programme.title: iCarly S5 - iPear Store
programme.desc: Freddie's new dream job becomes a nightmare when Sam gets hired too! Meanwhile, Carly tries to get a clueless guy to ask her out, and Spencer has to volunteer at the local firehouse.

programme.title: Victorious S3 - One Thousand Berry Balls
programme.desc: Andre gets Tori a job at a frozen yogurt stand, but work may keep them from performing at the Hollywood Arts Cowboy Luau. Robbie wants to ask Cat to the luau, but asks someone else, making Cat jealous.

programme.title: Sam & Cat S1 - #FirstClassProblems
programme.desc: When Sam and Cat are hired to take a pair of obnoxious kids on a flight to the Bahamas, they must first get through the challenges of the airport.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Donnie Hangs Tough
programme.desc: It's a battle of the wits between Donnie and Bishop as he races through NYC's subway system to stop her evil Mechazoids. But how do you beat an AI that counters your every move?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Leonardo Saddles Up

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis - EP2
programme.desc: Kris mendapatkan bantuan peguam dan melawat Salsa di penjara. Salsa kembali tersenyum apabila menerima nota inspirasi daripada kris.

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis - EP3
programme.desc: Salsa ditahan di penjara sementara menunggu perbicaraan. Kris semakin risau apabila wang simpanannya tidak mencukupi untuk menjamin salsa.

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis - EP4

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis - EP5
programme.desc: Datuk Kamil enggan menarik balik dakwaan terhadap salsa. Tok abah menawar diri untuk membayar duit jaminan buat Salsa & Fatimah berjaya membuktikan Salsa tidak bersalah.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. When his old nemesis resurfaces and kidnaps her for an underground trafficking ring, Dong Gu must rely on his heightened hearing and formidable combat skills to hunt down the criminals and rescue his daughter.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A triad boss seeks to clean up his image and win the mayoral seat amid a regime change. To raise funds and eliminate rivals, he sends Zheng Zha and Su Wan into action. When Zheng Zha’s undercover identity is exposed, he is killed by a corrupt superior, entrusting his mission to the mysterious Su Wan, who takes up the cause and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.
